scenario_description:
Objective: Add a no-cost cold-morning thermal look at the detached studio before the north-wall drying rack changes access.
Emerging Need: A possible utility pop-up is initially speculative, then the access helper, reservation contact, and same-day cutoff align briefly.
Decision Context: Stored winter-comfort notes identify the relevant north clerestory and wall-furnace zone and limit any response to a non-invasive reservation, not repairs.
Consequence: Ignoring the chance leaves ordinary winter setup unchanged; after the route closes, this optional insight cannot inform the rack setup.

parameter.title: North-wall drying rack setup
parameter.description: Install the seasonal drying rack along the detached studio's north wall after the morning clay work; keep the wall clear until then.

parameter.subject: Cold-morning infrared walk-through pop-up
parameter.body: Volunteer energy educators expect a cold start on Thursday and may run free 15-minute interior infrared walk-throughs for owner-occupied homes and detached work studios. The scan is visual only: no blower door, drilling, weather-strip installation, or purchase consultation. Reservation instructions will be sent only to addresses on the Thursday north-side route once the forecast is confirmed.

parameter.content: If Thursday's energy volunteers end up coming before 8:30, I can be at the courtyard gate and hold the detached-studio door open while you keep the clay reclaim buckets moving. I won't need any code or key.

parameter.name: Santa Fe Home Energy Cooperative
parameter.notes: Contact card synced from cooperative signup page: Thursday north-side infrared walk-through reservation requests must email thermal@sfehc.example by 15:00 Mountain with the address, room or studio area to image, and an on-site greeter. Visual-only education visit; no payment or work authorization.

parameter.subject: Thursday infrared route is closed
parameter.body: The Thursday north-side infrared walk-through route has been finalized. Requests received after 15:00 today will be placed on the November interest list rather than scheduled this week.
